title: Trustpilot
description: Display official Trustpilot service reviews on the storefront.
setup: In Trustpilot Business, open Showcase → Website widgets (TrustBox). Generate codes for a compact TrustScore widget and a service review list or carousel included in your plan. Copy the parameters below.
scope: Enabling replaces the store rating and homepage reviews. Product reviews remain separate. No API key is required. Only use widgets licensed to your business and domain.
help: Copy data-businessunit-id and data-template-id from the official codes. Both widgets must belong to the same business. Heights correspond to data-style-height in pixels. Choose a score widget suitable for a narrow mobile column. Do not paste HTML or scripts.
requestError: Unable to load or save Trustpilot settings. Check the values and try again.
validation: Enter your Trustpilot profile URL and 24-character hexadecimal IDs. All fields are required to enable display.
